articleTitle: Cotton Leaf Disease Classification using Deep Convolution Neural Network for Sustainable Cotton Production
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: The economic gainful of the country largely join on the crop production quality and quantity. The production profit can be improved by leaf disease detection in correct time. Many image processing methods have been developed for leaf disease detection. Technological improvement allows the task easier and faster at very early stage. Leaf disease is one of the major issue in the agriculture field. The Cotton leaves are affected by the disease named Cercospora, Bacterial blight, Ascochyta blight, and Target spot. General observation by farmers may time consume, expensive and sometimes inaccurate. For this, we introduce Deep Convolutional Neural Network based approach for identifying Cotton leaf diseases automatically. As per our understanding, Deep Convolutional Neural Network is used for the first time to detect cotton leaf disease. We train our data and assess the experimental result which displays the average accuracy of 96 %.

articleTitle: A Novel Technique based on Artificial Bee Colony for MR Brain Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Identification of tumor present in human brain plays a crucial role in the research of medical field. Many conventional techniques have been introduced, but still there is need of accuracy in the aspect of identifying the tumor and better visualization of tissue structures located in the human brain. The suggested Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) based Fuzzy C-Means (FCM) technique performs better segmentation of tissue portions and tumor regions located in MR brain images. Feasible cluster position is obtained by the Artificial Bee Colony algorithm and clustering operation is performed by using the Fuzzy C-Means algorithm. The efficiency of the proposed technique is validated using BRATS-SICAS (2015) dataset. Segmentation result produced by proposed Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) based Fuzzy C-Means (FCM) shows improved visualization of tumor and tissue structure and it is compared with competitive segmentation techniques like Particle swarm optimization (PSO). Dice overlap index (DOI) and Sensitivity produced by the recommended algorithm are 96.2±1.8 and 97±1.4, and they are quite impressive than the competitive segmentation techniques. This novel technique can be used as an effective method to localize the tumor portion in a more accurate way than the other demarcating techniques used in the research analysis of medical images analysis.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Handwritten Digit Recognizer using Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Ability for accurate digit recognizer modelling and prediction is critical for pattern recognition and security. A variety of classification machine learning algorithms are known to be effective for digit recognition. The purpose of this experiment is rapid assessment of multiple types of classification models on digit recognition problem. The work offers an environment for comparing four types of classification models in a unified experiment: Multiclass decision forest, Multiclass decision jungle, Multiclass Neural Network and Multiclass Logistic Regression. The work presents assessment results using 6 performance metrics: Overall accuracy, Average accuracy, Micro-averaged precision, Macro-averaged precision, Micro-averaged recall and Macro-averaged recall. The experimental results showed that the highest accuracy was obtained by Multiclass Neural Network with the value of 97.14%. The operational tool has been published to the web and openly available at Azure Machine Learning Studio for experiments and extensions.

articleTitle: Identification of Brain Tumor using Deep Learning Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Locating the brain tumor is the tough task in field of the medical. In this research work, an Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is developed based on auto context based on the global and local image features of two dimensional patches with different sizes. Different types of models are considered: 1) a voxel wise technique derived from two dimensional pathways with different direction (coronal, sagittal and axial) and also used three dimensional image without using expensive convolution networks: 2) A convolution network that has been fully automated based on principle of U-net architecture. To locate the boundaries of tumor in brain and other regions posterior probability maps is used via through the networks are used as context information and compared with the original image.

articleTitle: Synthesis of FIR Filter using ADC-DAC: A FPGA Implementation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Finite Impulse Response (FIR) filters are one of the most widely used in FPGA implementations owing to its linear phase Property and stability. The main attention of FIR filter implementation is towards noise and performance constraints. This paper, deals on design 8 bit and 8 taps FIR filter for filtering of Noise level and band pass filter for stabilizing the frequency. Analog to Digital convertor (ADC) has been with input frequency of 500Hz, sampling frequency of 2000Hz and the amplitude of 1mV Peak to Peak, which is given to Field Programmable Gate array (FPGA), in which the FIR filtering operation takes place, which results in optimization of noise by 13% comparing to the internal noise from analog signal and consume time less time period of 13.42ns as compared to other active algorithm and the output from FPGA is fed to Digital to Analog Converter for verifying the original input signal.

articleTitle: An Effective AVR-PSS Design for Electromechanical Oscillations Damping in Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: AVR stabilizes the terminal voltage of generator by controlling the exciter voltage. Fast action of AVR exciter module may cause negative damping of the system .With the presence of PSS, the oscillation occurred due to sudden AVR action has been suppressed. This paper emphasis the importance of AVR- PSS model in power system for damping the low frequency oscillation. The proposed model has been tested in Single Machine and Two area Four Machine system. The simulation analysis is performed using MATLAB and PSAT. The AVR-PSS model gives a better damping of electromechanical oscillations and improves the small signal stability.

articleTitle: An Improved Design for Neural-Network-Based Model Predictive Control of Three-Phase Inverters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: In recent days the voltage source inverters (VSI) controlled with several conventional control techniques usually contribute to variable switching frequency, as this control techniques produce tuning on the basis of ideal voltage status chosen during each sampling time. Variable switching frequencies create it hard to construct voltage source inverter input filters. As there is a great demand for the modern control techniques need for the contemporary 3-phase inverter tuning techniques with an input LC filter, that can generates quality and less presence of total harmonic distortion (THD) are required. This paper introduces improved scheme for a two-stage converter relies on the combination of model predictive controller (MPC) and improved feed-forward neural network, in order to reduce THD and improve the system's continuous and dynamic performance for various kinds of load. First, in the training stage, MPC is used as an expert to produce information necessary to train the proposed neural network. That can have perfect tuning, for effective online training without using MPC for voltage monitoring purposes. The improved control strategy is simulated using the MATLAB/ Simulink tool, carrying different load conditions into consideration.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm Based Approach for the Determination of Optimal Locations and Observability of Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) Under Smart Grid Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Phasor Measurement Units (PMU) are used to monitor, protect and control power system networks and have become increasingly essential in latest years. In this paper, Genetic algorithm-based method is suggested for optimal positioning of the phasor measurement device. Identifying optimal locations of PMU is a main problem in the implementation of PMU. Full observability and minimum number of PMU are the two main considerations to be regarded during the PMU positioning phase. To ensure complete observability, it is not appropriate to consider only the baseline cases, but also contingency cases. The system's contingency classification is performed by the RBF network. The suggested technique is validated on the IEEE 14 and New England 39 bus schemes further the outcomes are contrasted with traditional techniques.

articleTitle: Image Enhancement Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: This paper presented a Convolutional Neutral Network (CNN) based technique to perform image enhancement the contrast of images can be adaptively improved. At the point when an image is caught under inadequate dimensions, the pixel values are in a low dynamic range, which will cause image quality to descend apparently. Hence, it is important to improve the nature of images. So as to safeguard image surfaces however much as could reasonably be expected, and the use SSIM loss. DnCNN grasps the advancement in profound engineering, learning calculation and regularization technique into image denoising. DnCNN certainly evacuates the inactive clean image in the shrouded unit layers. Finally, this CNN method has increased the PSNR value and reduce the SSIM value.

articleTitle: Automated PE32 Threat Classification using Import Table and Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: A malware is a computer program which harms the computer in which it gets executed. Malware analysis plays a major role in analysing the functionalities and behaviour of the malware. Malware analysis is a slow and tedious process which involves a lot of manual work. Finding the type of the malware will often boost up the analysis process and helps to the researcher to know what the binary executable is capable of. Usually researchers perform various static analysis techniques to find the category of the malware using various tools like strings, dependency walker etc., Classifying them manually is a non-feasible solution. So, in this paper, we are proposing an automated approach for malware classification using deep neural networks.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimation of Battery Pack in EV using Extended Kalman Filters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Estimating state-of-charge (SoC) for Lithium-ion (Li-ion) battery is the key issue in battery management system (BMS). Now a days they are widely used in many industrial applications, especially in electric vehicle (EV). SoC estimation in BMS plays an important role in ensuring safety, reliability and better battery life for EV. This work describes digital-twin model for parameter identification and extended kalman filter (EKF) is used for estimating the battery pack's parameters and SoC. State space model of EV battery is developed and it is used for EKF estimation. With this the present and previous conditions of SoC is monitored, it is simulated using battery parameters obtained from a typical EV battery pack. The simulation results show the efficacy of approach to provide accurate estimates of SoC.

articleTitle: Prediction of Blood Glucose Level by using an LSTM based Recurrent Neural networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Diabetes is one of the most important diseases that affect the patient Internal Organs, Circulation System, Eyesight and also the entire body. Based on the international Diabetic federation survey there are 366 million peoples affected by diabetes and this will be expected to rise about 552 by the year of 2030. A diabetic patient needs to monitor their glucose level regularly in order to maintain the blood glucose level. By maintaining the proper blood glucose level, patients can control the complications due to diabetes. In this work LSTM network is used to model the blood glucose level, it is a type of RNN. Data collected from the diabetic patient is used in modelling and the model is validated.

articleTitle: Smart Meter Data Analytics for Load Prediction using Extreme Learning Machines and Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Load forecasting is one of the essential component in Smart Grid operation as it plays a significant role in making decisions such as planning, generation scheduling and operation, electricity pricing, customer satisfaction and system security. The date old load forecasting problem has received renewed efforts due to the arrival of Smart Meters in the Smart Grid system. Residential load forecasting is a relatively new area focusing the customer load prediction. Unlike the aggregate level load forecasting, residential load forecasting is difficult due to the high variable nature of residential load curves. A comparison of load forecasting algorithm using Extreme Learning Machines(ELM) with the traditional approach using Neural Networks (NN) is presented in this paper. Smart meter data obtained from a residential customer is used for testing the performance of the proposed hybrid algorithm. The accuracy and efficiency of the model is analyzed using statistical parameters like MAE, MAPE and RMSE. Based on the experimental results ELM based load forecasting gives better accuracy when compared to the traditional NN based algorithm.

articleTitle: Enhancement of LVRT Capability in Grid Connected Wind Energy Systems using Crowbar
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: This work handles the improvement of LVRT competency of double-fed induction generator (DFIG) driven grid-integrated wind energy conversion systems (WECS) using crowbar. In this paper, a series crowbar resistance with an IGBT is recommended to enhance the Fault-Ride-Through ability of the 1.5 MW WECS and also the low voltage ride through testing device is also simulated. The simulation results demonstrate that the crowbar absorbs the high fault current during a fault in the grid, improves the LVRT capability and with the help of LVRT testing device, unsymmetrical faults could be applied at required levels by changing the resistance values. The efficacy of the suggested technique is validated in Matlab Simulink through thorough simulation.

articleTitle: An Open and Short Circuit Switch Fault of Power Converters in PM-BLDC Motor in Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: PM-BLDC Motor based drive is simple, reliable and most widely used drive for Electric Vehicle (EV) applications. This paper proposes the fault diagnostic method to detect switch fault in PM-BLDC motor drive power converters. It was possible to detect both open and short circuit faults by this proposed technique.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Smart Meter Data Analytics for Electricity Load Prediction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: In the smart grid era, Smart Meter data is playing a vital role. The residential load forecasting is one of the major issue that uses the Smart Meter data. It is high volatile load data due to its nature of variability in load pattern. The load pattern of every customer varies with respect to certain factors like demographic information, environmental factors, time stamp, etc. Load pattern-based customer clustering, aggregated load value based customers classification are certain conventional method used for addressing the load forecasting. It is less likely to address forecasting issue using the conventional method. To overcome this downside, this research proposes the deep learning based load forecasting method that uses the aggregated smart meter dataset along with the demographic dataset. The performance of the deep neural network (DNN) is compared with shallow network that outperform with the error calculation.

articleTitle: Closed-loop Control of BLDC Motor in Electric Vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: This paper presents the closed-loop control (CLC) simulation for Brushless Direct Current (BLDC) motor used in electric vehicle (EV) application. There are many methods available to control BLDC motor, here a comparative study between conventional and auto-tuned optimal controller method for PID is reported. To ensure the quality of work, the motor parameters are estimated from real-time motor by experiments and it is used in simulation to study its performance thoroughly. From this it is concluded that auto-tuned PID controller has good track efficiency in achieving the target speed, torque and current variations can also be reduced.

articleTitle: Randomized Gossip Algorithm based RSU Distribution for VANETs leveraging Fog Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: With the advent of smart cities, there is a necessity to control the road traffic and vehicular accidents. VANET is an ideal solution for incorporating this requirement. The primary necessity for VANET is the road side units (RSUs). The efficiency and effectiveness of the RSU determines the performance of the VANET. In this paper we propose an Optimal RSU orchestration for VANET architecture based on fog computing. The proposed architecture exhibits better response times compared to many state-of-the-art VANET architectures. The randomized gossip protocol guarantees effective load balancing of the RSUs, thus minimizing the number of RSUs and the cost of installation.

articleTitle: Improving Energy Efficiency and Quality of Service in Wireless Body Area Sensor Network using Versatile Synchronization Guard Band Protocol
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: In the last few years there has been a growing interest in Wireless Body Area Network (WBAN) due to its latency and enhance the health care features by continuously monitoring the condition of the patient and early identification of problems. A major difficulty has been occurring to design network such as Medium Access Control (MAC) protocol that primarily part of the WBANs for functioning in a well-organized way. Therefore, it limits the sensor node energy for Quality of Service (QOS) and life cycle of the network. Accordingly, this work introduces a Versatile Synchronization Guard Band Protocol (VSGP) namely VSGP, which deals with guard band (GB) in each time slot it reduces the interference of the transmitting signal and increase the efficiency of QOS and its energy. WBAN performed with more number of sensor nodes are connected to the coordinator. VSGP protocol is compared with two existing methods called Self Adaptive Guard Band (SAGB) and Traditional Guard Band protocol. Comparisons are made with time and packet flow of each transmission and energy per packet flow.

articleTitle: Analysis of Hybrid Power Flow Controller using Static load model under Contingency Screening
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: A Static load model is a correlation between measured voltage at a bus, active and reactive energy dissipated by the load connected at an instant. Load model structure plays a vital role in the effect of appropriate contingencies, and this can alter the ranked lists used by the system. Newton-Raphson (N-R) power flow method used for examining multiple load models on the transmission system. HPFC is a lately introduced member of flexible AC transmission system (FACTS). This paper presents a comparison of HPFC using static load modelling on the transmission system. Load flow is brought out on each decided policy for the base case-load and pre-contingency conditions. The formulation of a query is set to be ill-conditioned if estimated values are very susceptible to minute changes in input conditions. Contingency screening for static load model has experimented on the IEEE 14-bus system using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Managing Crop for Indian Farming Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Farming in India is done using the routine ways in most of the places. Since most of our farmers lack in proper technical knowledge, state is even more erratic. Farming and agricultural activities are based on the predictions which may fail. Due to such uncertainties, farmers have to bear huge losses and sometimes they may end up life by committing suicide. Since we know the benefits of proper soil moisture and its quality, light intensity, humidity levels and temperature which are very important for the growth of crops and such parameters cannot be ignored. We propose new idea of Smart Crop Monitoring System implemented using Internet of Things for sensing environmental conditions and forwarding the data, Machine Learning to generate decisions for crop management based on the data, Cloud for storage and an Android application interface for operation of the system. We believe that our concept will be very useful in the agribusiness due to its reliability and remote monitoring. Smart Agro will be useful for farmers for planning and digitizing their agricultural activities. So, the farmers can check on the requirements of the crops and accurately predict their growth. This concept will surely accelerate their business to reach new heights and also be more profitable. The significance of this paper includes in Smart Agro are SMS notifications with the language preference, valuable information collection, detailed data analysis, cost effective, easy to implement, Automatic Motor Control And Automatic Greenhouse Lights Control.

Author Keywords: SMS Notifications with the Language Preference (SLP)

articleTitle: Human Age Estimation based on Ear Biometrics using KNN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: At Present, humans have several peculiar and exclusive biometrics characteristic features which help to distinguish as part of identification. Basically, biometrics diagnose the people by surveying few aspects of individual anatomy or physiology such as Face, Fingerprint, FKP, Palm print, iris, etc., Likewise the ear recognition system are considered to be the most powerful tool in forensic application. This work presents a detailed analysis of the extraction of soft biometrics traits such as age- gender from each individual which help in contributing several identification decisions by primary biometrics and also to improve the matching Performance. In this work age of several persons are trained from Ear dataset with Gabor feature extraction with the modified version of KNN and the results are evaluated with the Performance Examination based on matching ratio based on the comparison status with KNN.

articleTitle: Super Capacitor Based Energy Recovery System from Regenerative Braking used for Electric Vehicle Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Electric vehicles, when it is running in frequent start and stop pattern in urban road condition, significant amount of energy is wasted in wheels during braking. Instead of wasting energy, the kinetic energy can be converted into electrical energy and stored in super capacitors. The super capacitors are electric double layer capacitors with rating of farads. The stored energy can be re used, thus supporting batteries to supply the peak power demand. The bidirectional converter is proposed to charge and discharge the super capacitor. By using proposed method, the energy recovery and efficiency of overall drive has been improved. The simulation has been done and results were plotted to verify the proposed topology.

articleTitle: MR Brain image segmentation for the volumetric measurement of tissues to differentiate Alzheimer’s disease using hybrid algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Structural variation in MR brain image is an essential tool to identify Alzheimer's disease (AD). Gray matter reduction, cortical thickness and the volume of hippocampal which have been very useful to discriminate the severity of AD. These anatomical MRI volumes have been used so far to differentiate AD. In this study, combination of multiple MRI anatomical measures have taken to increase the diagnostic of AD. Patch Image Differential clustering (PIDC) principle is employed to initialize the cluster center. Three various clusters are assigned to segment the Grey Matter(GM), White Matter(WM), Cerebrospinal Fluid(CSF) and hippocampus region and the volume of each segmented region is measured to differentiate AD and Mild Cognitive Imapairment(MCI). Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm is also adopted with PIDC to improve the segmentation accuracy. The proposed PIDC with PSO algorithm provided 92% segmentation accuracy and the segmentation results were compared with bench markimages.

articleTitle: Application of Comprehensive Learning Particle Swarm Optimization to Least Cost Generation Expansion Planning Problem with Solar Plant
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Generation Expansion Planning (GEP) is a challenging problem as both supply and demand for energy have temporal and spatial variations. It also involves integration of system elements with a complex mix of alternative candidate plants having differing physical and production capabilities and characteristics. The integration of all such elements in a system framework makes the GEP a large-scale, long-term, non-linear, mixed-variable mathematical modeling problem. The accurate solution of such realistic models is essential to create an efficient and economic power system.In recent years a number of solution methodologies have been proposed to solve the models and to address the efficiency issue. The Comprehensive Learning Particle Swarm Optimization (CL-PSO) algorithm is drawing more and more attention of the researchers and it has been applied in the solution of GEP in many recent studies. The aim of this study is the GEP for the candidate system, integrating all critical system elements leading to the formulation of a realistic mathematical system and the employment of GEP in the model solutions. It also demonstrates the effectiveness of CL-PSO algorithm in finding efficient solutions to the identified problem. The test system planning is carried out for two different planning horizons of 6 and 14 years respectively. As the system is expected to get an increasing proportion of solar power plants, in future, a special focus is given to study the impact of such increase. The resulting variations in different cost components and the variations in reliability indices are also reported.

articleTitle: RGA based Optimal Parameter Estimation of Diode Model for Solar Photo-Voltaic Array Emulator Development
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: The research on Solar Photo-Voltaic (PV) based Energy Conversion (SPEC) system requires an expensive and composite experimental setup. Therefore, PV source emulator is an essential component to evaluate the performance of SPEC system source under varying environmental conditions. This paper presents the design and development of solar PV Array Emulator (PVAE) using Programmable DC power supply. The PV module in the PVAE is designed with five parameter diode model. The parameters of the PV module is estimated using Real-coded Genetic Algorithm. The PV array is developed in the Multisim software and replicated with the support of programmable DC power source using LabVIEW. The proposed PVAE works on the online load tracking algorithm and does not require memory space to store the characteristic curve lookup table of the PV array. The prototype of the proposed PVAE is tested with a 800 W solar PV array along with Maximum Power Point Tracking algorithm and the performance of the developed system is reported in this paper.

Author Keywords: Five parameter single-diode PV cell model

articleTitle: An Efficient Non-dominated sorting Genetic algorithm II (NSGA II) for Optimal Operation of Micro grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: The paper deals with minimization of the economic problem occurs in a Microgrid. It is a technology arising now a day to satisfy the nearby load demand and to reduce the expenses. Generally, Microgrid consist of renewable resources such as Wind Turbine, Solar Panels, Fuel cell, Micro turbine, CHP etc. In case of crisis in emergency situations, Microgrid can be able to activate Diesel Engine generator(DEG) as a power backup or it can purchase power from the microgrid. The main objective of the paper is to minimize the Operating cost, Fuel cost of DEG, the power transaction cost and to reduce Voltage deviation by finding the best location for connecting the Microgrid. The load constraints and operational constraints are considered. Based on the load demand available excess power can be sold to the Main grid or required power can be purchased from the main grid. The sharing of power between microgrid and main grid reduces the total operational cost. The problem has been implemented with Non-dominated sorting Genetic algorithm II (NSGA II).

articleTitle: Mobility Handling in Cluster based Mobile Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: `Mobility handling' process is considered to be very important in a cluster-based MWSN. In a clustered architecture of a mobile network, the CH monitors its member, transmits data and handle mobility. In this paper, a time-stamp based algorithm is proposed to predict mobility and hand off the nodes. Simulation results explained that proposed algorithm performs well in both single and double clustered architecture which helps in load balancing. The latency of handling mobility of time-stamp based algorithm is 9.1 times less than the existing M-LEACH algorithm.

articleTitle: Low Voltage Ride-Through Capability Enhancement of Grid-Connected Photovoltaic Systems- A Hybrid Control Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Under the demands of contemporary grid code (GC), the solar PV system should stay attached to the grid for a certain time period depend on the voltage sag level under the fault condition. The voltage of the point of common coupling (PCC) is very low when the fault appears on the grid side, resulting in a very high DC connection voltage for the power balance. This high voltage of the intermediate circuit can damage the drive. Moreover, the deflection of the voltage will cause the PV plant to be disconnected from the network based on the modern GCs. This study proposes a hybrid control approach for the two-stage grid-integrated solar PV system to enhance low voltage ride through (LVRT). The hybrid control approach proposed consists of a braking chopper and a neutral connected braking resistor (NCBR).The braking chopper resistance absorbs the excess energy in DC link capacitor during the fault, which will regulate the DC-link overvoltage. The NCBR is stabilized the impact of grid faults and therefore the voltage sag is improve in the grid side, which is boost the PV system's LVRT capability. For this work, the algorithm of synchronization evolved to trigger both controls simultaneously under the fault. Simulations are carried out using the MATLAB/Simulink software under all types of fault and results indicate that the proposed hybrid control scheme can enhance the LVRT capability of the system.

articleTitle: Life-Time Maximization of Wireless Sensor Network Using Jaya Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Clustering is an effective way to enhance the lifetime of the Wireless Sensor Network. Moreover, due to the additional workload, cluster heads (CHs) use extra power to obtain data from other sensor nodes, combine the collected data and communicate the corresponding data to the base station. Moreover, inaccurate cluster formation may overload the cluster heads with extra nodes. Because of these excess nodes, cluster heads can rapidly die, leading to degradation of the effectiveness of WSN. In this work, a grid-based CHs assignment methodology is proposed for even distribution of CHs in the WSN to maximize lifetime, and Jaya algorithm does optimization. Results of the simulation showed that grid-based CH assignment provides maximum lifetime as compared to the random CH assignment method, and the jaya algorithm provides a better solution than the existing one.

articleTitle: Generalized Multi-Level Inverter for Symmetrical and Asymmetrical Configurations with Reduced Switch Count
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: This paper presents a single phase symmetrical and asymmetrical multilevel inverter for generation of synthesizing a sinusoidal voltage with TSTSTD (Two Source Two Switches and Two Diode) circuit. This paper concentrates to generate the maximum stepped voltage with reduced number of dc sources. The proposed configuration needs less turned ON switches to get the desired level. The less turned on switches' configuration reduces the conduction losses, since total losses is the addition of conduction losses and switching losses. The proposed topology is modeled and simulated in MATLAB/ Simulink 2018a version. The proposed circuit is studied and compared with other topologies in terms of blocking voltage, Total Harmonic Distortion, number of levels, and number of switches.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of ANN-BP, ELM for MRI Pancreas Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a modern way of detecting tumour in medical field. The convenience of MRI is soft tissue contrast and non invasiveness. Inconvenience of MRI is huge time employing in the physician outcome. To avoid the inconvenience of MRI, we use automated classifiers. This research work is use to detect the tumour in pancreas organ of our human body. We use 160 pancreas MR images were detected by normal or abnormal applying two automated classifiers such as ANN-BP and ELM. These classifiers can appreciably modernize the detection process in terms of both lesser amount of time and classification accuracy. We extract features using second order feature extraction and detect the pancreas medical image as normal or abnormal. Among two classification approaches, ANN-BP achieves superior accuracy (96%) when compared to ELM, While ELM performs faster compared to ANN-BP.

articleTitle: The Efficacy of Capturing Lateral View Breast Thermograms
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Breast thermography is having a higher potential in detecting breast abnormalities due to high vascular indications beneath the abnormal regions of the breast. Hence, a thorough analysis of the features pertaining to the classification of these thermograms is necessary to emphasize the efficiency of the pattern classification. Image processing techniques such as feature extraction and pattern classification is applied to the acquired breast database. In comparison with the frontal views, the lateral view thermograms show better performance when classified with the pattern classifiers. The result shows 87% accuracy using KNN for the lateral view of breast thermograms.

articleTitle: Designing Communication System for Person with Locked in Syndrome Using Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Electrroculogram (EOG) based Human Computer Interaction (HCI) research was growing day by day due to need of new handheld assistive devices for the persons with Locked in Syndrome (LIS). For that particular disability only the solution was to develop communication devices to overcome their problem. So we conducted our experiment with ten subjects using Randomized Hough Transform (RHT) and Random Forest Tree Classifier (RFT). During the study, all the subjects were male subjects and their age was ranged from 30 to 45. At the end of the study we obtained the average maximum accuracy of 94.48% and mean minimum accuracy of 88.90% and mean average accuracy of 92.77% for RFT classifier. Best classification accuracy of individual subjects was obtained for the subject S4 with average mean classification accuracy of 93.96%. The minimal classification accuracy of individual subjects was attained by the subject S8 with average mean classification accuracy of 91.70%. The study concluded that individual performances were presented in between 93.96% to 91.70% and finalized that expanding the command signals to handle the exterior machines like wheelchair, TV Remote, mouse, game controller, mobile phone controller, alarm controller, keyboard and home Appliances were possible for disbaled person in usual way.

articleTitle: ECU design for BLDC motor using TrueTime
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: With the current transport, the environment becomes polluted. Electric Vehicle, which is powered by batteries, is the best option for reducing environmental pollution and fuel shortage. The Electric Vehicle's primary element is the motor and its controller. Brushless Direct Current motor used in most of the Electric Vehicle. The high performance, high torque-to-weight ratio, and brushless design make BLDC motor usable. This paper uses the PI controller to investigate the design of an Electronic Control Unit (ECU) for three-phase BLDC motor. To control ECU's PI controller parameter, the NSGA-II (Nondominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm) tool is optimized and applied with the Controller Area Network (CAN) True Time Validation. PI controller gains confirmed use of True Time software tool with CAN to validate the design. By using True Time with Controller Area Network, the IGBT Gate scheduling is supervised and regulated by the PI controller.An efficient optimisation tool is used to regulate the speed controller PI controller parameters. In True Time, the computed gains from the controller are simulated to validate the design to verify the performance in controller for a given switch scheduling. The simulation findings indicate that these techniques are validated.

articleTitle: On-Line Estimation of ATC Using Neural Network With Selective Features
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: In any power system with deregulated environment, the capability of transferring power -ATC of the system needs to be updated every hour or every day. This will help market participants to plan their transmission transactions. The existing methods of calculating ATC need large computational time, as well as they are not effective for online techniques. Hence, it is significant to evaluate ATC values accurately at a lesser time. Here, neural network approach is used for on-line ATC estimation for both bilateral and multilateral transactions under normal and contingency condition. The main feature of this method is the reduction of size for extending the capability. Overall design is enhanced based on the mutual information feature selection. IEEE bus system is tested and the obtained output is distinguished with Repeated Power Flow (RPF) results. The output reveals that the proposed strategy is best suited for online calculation.

articleTitle: The Detection and Mitigation of Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDOS) Attacks in Software Defined Networks using Distributed Controllers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Software defined networking is vital technology that involves decoupling the control and data planes in the network. The separation of the control and data planes offers a dynamic, manageable, flexible, and powerful platform. On the other hand, a centralized network platform presents situations that challenge security, such as, for instance, a DDOS attack on the centralized controller. Given their centralized nature, SDNs are likely to be susceptible to single-contact failures. This study proposes a collaborative approach for DDOS attack detection in a distributed SDN multicontroller platform. It also analyses DDOS attacks in distributed controllers, which differ from centralized controllers in SDNs. The study detects attacks and provides an attack mitigation process through the implementation of a monitoring solution that uses the POX controller with the Open vSwitch.

articleTitle: Thermo Electric Generator fed LVDC System analyzed with non Linear Loads
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Now a days large household loads are operated in DC.But the low voltage DC use causes harmonics problems.The objective of this research is the performance of thermo electric generator fed LVDC system in non linear loads.Thermo electric generator (TEG) is a semi conductor device to convert temperature difference across the metal to electric voltage. The use of non linear loads also produces harmonics. We want to reduce the harmonics and effective utilization of TEG voltage. The electric vehicles and renewable energy resources generate and use DC voltage. So this voltage can be interface with distribution network. DC network distribution is more efficient than AC network distribution. Due to this reason DC distribution is used in house hold applications. In this work the utilization of DC generated from Thermo electric generator is discussed.

articleTitle: Ear Biometric Detection Using Edge-Map Generation Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Edge map generation technique is the most significant task in image processing systems to detect certain objects in an image, which contain vital information about objects of an image. Therefore, this paper proposes a method to detect ear using edge map generation technique along with canny edge detection using IIT Delhi database ear images. The edge map generation technique generates two different edge maps of same ear images is implemented into a single edge-map that combines Gaussian filtering to enhance the illuminations, image binarization and canny edge detection. These subsequent steps make it suitable to achieve high edge map generation technique. The false edges are drastically reduced by the proposed edge map generation technique as well as for accurate and fast ear detection which was tested with IIT Delhi ear database. Among all other edge detections, the canny edge detection gives better performances and provides the best result. The MATLAB software is used to execute the proposed technique. The analyzed parameters are evaluated as PSNR, RMSE and error edge map.

articleTitle: RIT: Remaining Inter-Contact Time based Routing for Intermittent Connected Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: In an Intermittent Connected Network, node's mobility causes intermittent connectivity between nodes resulting in partitioned networks or clusters of the network, hence complete path will not always exist. Low resource utilization technique causes long latency whereas high routing performance technique produces a huge number of redundancies leading to quick depletion of resources. It is obviously that merging replication control mechanism with replication-based technique will attain great routing performance with low overhead. Inspired by this observation, a novel technique called Remaining Inter Contact time-based Routing (RIT) is proposed. The proposed work enhances the replication-based technique considering remaining inter-contact time between two nodes as routing utility. As a result, RIT selects relays in an increasing value of delivery predictability. Thus, the proposed work achieves the 25% improvement in packet delivery rate than the state-of-the-art protocols for increasing network size. In addition, RIT takes the least delay with reduced overhead. We evaluated RIT inan Opportunistic Network Environment (ONE) simulator specially designed for DTN type networks, which shows that RIT avoids unnecessary replication and performs well in a wide range of intermittently connected networks.

articleTitle: Analysis of Perturb and Observe Algorithm Using Double Diode Model for Different Converters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: In this work, maximum power point of solar panel is tracked by perturb and observe algorithm with boost and SEPIC converters. The converter operations along with solar panel are simulated in MATLAB/Simulink. Simulation studies have been carried out with different temperature and irradiation. PV array type system is interconnected with a DC- DC boost converter and SEPIC Converter that operates based upon the number of pulses of MPPT to obtain the PV model. The simulation results show that the converter is purely based on the P&O algorithm. Finally, the efficiency of both converters is shown in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis for Energy Storage Systems for Transport and Grid Applications using SMES devices with PWM-CSC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: For several years, energy storages have attracted the focus of the transport society. Recent advances in hybrid and plug-in electric vehicles along with new transport ideas such as electric vehicles are the reason why energy storage has played such a large part in transport. The requirements for energy storage solutions differ considerably from transport implementation to implementation, rendering it hard for the scientific community to merge into one, all-encompassing energy storage alternative. Due to its quick response, a high energy storage efficiency and, in particular, large quantities of load energy during small periods of time, the SMES schemes have drawn the notice of electrical companies. This paper provides efficient and dynamic power monitoring for low-voltage manufacturing grids using superconducting magnetic energy storage (SMES) systems via non-linear input control. The SMES unit is linked to the system with a current source converter with a pulse width modulation (PWM-CSC). The dynamic model has a non-linear property which is controlled by the non-linear controller with feedback mechanism based on the estimated behavior of the closed loop system. In order to monitor the stability features of the suggested device, the continuous condition assessment under the time-dome reference system is used.

articleTitle: FLC based DC Link Voltage regulation in DFIG Driven Grid Connected Wind Energy Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: The demand for wind power is increasing day by day as the fuel cost is zero. Nowadays the penetration of wind power into the grid is growing more and more. The grid integration of wind power causes undesirable stability as the wind speed is intermittent in nature. It is essential to investigate the DC Link capacitor voltage level as it ensures the constant output power at the Point of Common Coupling (PCC). The DC link capacitor plays significant role in the aspect of contributing stability to the grid connected inverter during the momentary behaviour thereby reflects the grid stability. In this work, the DC link capacitor voltage controlled by Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC) and Proportional - Integral (PI) controller are compared and the performance of the Fuzzy Logic Controller for maintaining constant DC link voltage and Reactive power at PCC has been done. The Matlab/ Simulink results show the effectiveness of the FLC.

articleTitle: Analysis of Improved H6 Topology for grid-tied PV System to Minimize Leakage Current
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: The fundamental work done in this paper is to limit the leakage currents of grid tied PV system by using the improved H6 topology. These leakage currents are diminished by the lessening of maximum recurrence voltage transients in the terminal and normal mode voltages. By utilizing PWM method, the high recurrence voltage transients can be decreased. An incremental conductance technique is utilized to track the most extreme power point from P-V graph of PV system. Correlation of existing CMLI (Cascaded Multilevel Inverter Topology) and enhanced H6 topology is clarified in this paper. THD (Total Harmonic Distortion)of the system is decreased in this topology.

articleTitle: Simulation of Rectangular GAA NWMBCFET for sub 35nm using TCAD
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: In this paper, a cylindrical GAA NWFET (Gate All around Nano wire Field Effect Transistor) is compared with a rectangular GAA NWMBCFET (Gate All around Nano Wire Multi Bridge Channel Field Effect Transistor) for sub 35nm devices using TCAD (Technology Computer Aided Design) simulation tool. In a rectangular GAA NWMBCFET a total of 6 thin channels instead of one channel are created with equal distance in vertical and horizontal stacking. The device performance using coupled Drift-diffusion (DD) method and Shockley-Read-Hall Recombination method (SRH) has been numerically evaluated. Comparisons have been performed between cylindrical GAA NWFET and rectangular GAA NWFET, as well as between rectangular GAA NWFET and rectangular GAA NWMBCFET using TCAD numerical simulation calibrations to evaluate the transfer and output characteristics. Due to the presence of Ultra-Thin Body (UTB) in the multi bridge channel the current drive of the device is increased. The reduction in influence of short channel effects has been addressed by the GAA structure.

articleTitle: Improved Electronics Medical Records (EMR) Security Using Fuzzy C-Mean and Reversible Data Hiding for Teleradiology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: In the medical field, the high range of retrieving patient details embedded information may create more sarcastic issues and unreliability of data. The damage in patient detail embedded data will leads to more ethical and complicated social issues to the patients and it may ruin the trustworthiness of the health care system. In most of the technology assisted in health care system must be take some health records as their reference. Medical images such as MRI scanning images have a great role to identify the diagnosis part of the health care system and also it is used as the input data for technological aspects. Therefore we have to take more preventive measures to these medical images from damages and other issues. The medical imageintegrity, reliability and authenticity will keep up by some of the security mechanisms. Many of the methods derived in this era. But there are lot of limitations too. This paper proposes new method using Fuzzy C means and more efficient cryptographic methodsare embedded in this to develop a more sophisticated way to increase credibility of medical images and also by giving a strong link between images and information without losing the image quality for the end user.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Device Performance on AlGaN/InGaN/GaN High Electron Mobility Transistors (HEMTs) using TCAD Software
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: In recent years, High-Electron-Mobility Transistors (HEMTs) have received great attention for its superior electron transport guaranteeing high speed and high- p o w e r applications. HEMT devices are competitors with and substitution previous field-effect transistors (FETs) with amazing performance at high frequency, improved power density and satisfactory potency. This work concentrates on designing and simulating the AlGaN/InGaN/GaN High electron mobility transistor by using the TCAD simulation software and evaluating the drain current and breakdown voltage performances. The obtained output will be brought in comparison with the existing AlGaN/GaN HEMT and the device performances will prove to be better for the proposed structure. Other parameters such as threshold voltage Vth, On/Off current and transconductance (g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>) could be evaluated in TCAD for this structure. The effect of proton irradiation on the DC performance of InGaN/GaN HEMT with dielectric layers will be studied later. The basic mechanism underlying the high radiation tolerance appears to be the strong internal piezoelectric field near the two- d i m e n s i o n a l electron gas (2DEG). The radiation damage occurring in the proposed HEMT structure will be compared with that of the effects in AlGaN/GaN hetero-structure and will be validated.

articleTitle: Component Modeling of ROME
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Micro-grid represents a fundamental part of a modern electrical system is to promote the incorporation of renewable DG units. The primary aim of micro-grid is to obtain the capacity of work. The energy storage system and DG will offer unique cases and there is plenty of power production from RES and continues each energy storage system. DG maintains a broad variety of modern technologies, like gas turbines, micro-turbines, photovoltaic (PV), fuel cells, also wind-power. Resiliency specifies that the capacity of power systems to resist reasonable probability and severe impact occurring in an effective way. In this paper, various component models of Resilient and Optimal Micro Energy-Grid (ROME) are instants. The simulation of solar and the wind turbine are performing, and the results discussed.

articleTitle: High Performance Double Gated Molybdenum Disulfide (MoS2) Transistor for Low Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: This paper presents an enhanced drain current performance for a Double gated Molybdenum Disulfide (MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) transistor.The drain current for the device is obtained using the Technology Computer-Aided Design (TCAD)simulation software.The above mentioned comparison model of drain current built using the Double gated MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> transistor has shown superior performances when compared with that of Silicon transistor. Due to capability to perform in low power operating voltages, MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> transistor has found suitable for low power applications.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement with Minimum number of Switches using Fifteen Level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Heart of power system is power quality improvement. The harmonics are produced by power electronics devices. The harmonics and distortions produced by conventional inverters are reduced by using filters which in turn increases the size and cost of these equipment. The basic voltages can be modulated very accurately by using very small step size and making it suitable for utility. The desired A.C voltage can be produced from D.C voltage using a fifteen level inverter with minimum number of switches. This proposed system uses only seven switches. The use of less number of switches will improve the efficiency of the power device. By using fifteen level inverter the unbalanced voltage occurring at the supply side can be eliminated. Cascaded H-bridge inverters are a type of modular inverters. In this type of system the renewable energy source like solar can be integrated with the load to eliminate the transformer. This paper deals with the sinusoidal PWM for generating pulses to the inverter.

articleTitle: Performance Degradation and Revival of Old Solar Power Plants & their Batteries
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Upon remote monitoring of more than 25 off grid battery supported solar mini grids in India for over 2 years, it has been observed that battery output of all such systems reduced by 50% - 60% in 3 years of operation and further reduced to 30%-40% in 5 years of operation with overall output of solar PV also reducing considerably in this period. The batteries in solar PV systems are seen to give less than half the design life prescribed by manufacturers and BIS standards. This occurs due to "hard sulphation" which can be reduced by a proper discharging process & removed by special charge treatment. Lab scale experiments to provide the equalization charge to solar batteries and their on ground applications prove that batteries of solar PV plants can provide more than 80% of their rated capacity for 8 to 10 years or more, provided charge and discharge process and periodic freshening is done.

articleTitle: Multi Biometric Authentication: A Secure Method with Modified Local Binary Pattern and PCA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Biometrics is an inevitable scheme in today's scenario to grant authentication for different protection systems. Still single level of biometric techniques cannot meet the expected level of accuracy, multi biometric method is much more efficient to achieve accuracy, authentication palm print technique is more easy and reliable but the requirement for perfect matching system can't be satisfied by means of it. So,by integrating the palm vein features with palm print,the perfect harmonizing can be achieved, reliable and anti spoof results for the system is possible. In this work, PCA based adaptive Gabor filter is chosen for palm print feature extraction and for vein extraction the improved version of Local Binary Pattern (LBP) is integrated with Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN). Finally the outcome of above process is logically mixed (Boolean AND) to identify the correct person.

Author Keywords: Modified of the Local Binary Pattern

articleTitle: An Overview Of Single Phase Matrix Converter Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: An Overview of applications of Matrix Converter is presented. Single Phase Matrix Converter topology has many advantages. It is flexible and can replace many converter topologies by its wide applications as universal converter. The major influences in the research field such as the application extensions, modulation methods are compiled and then extended with explanations of the corresponding area of research. The wide scope of Matrix Converter applications in single phase and its future potential concludes this review.

articleTitle: Medical Imaging Data Security using Effective Honey with Ant-Lion Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Security is the one of the significant thing for transmitting the restorative information,in the same time it contains some extra information of patients. Medical Imaging Data Security is a Necessary system for secure the sensitive information and their related patient data and the information are put away and transmitted over the open system. Numerous cryptographic calculations are accessible, and they fall under symmetric, asymmetric and other procedures. To choose an algorithm for secure information correspondence, the algorithm ought to give higher Privacy, security and better effectiveness. Here in Medical Imaging data, Honey encryption is used to scramble the restorative medical data. After that the Ant-Lion optimization is used to overhaul the keys. The presentation of the future methodology is assessed utilizing different estimates such as, Peak Signal to Noise ratio (PSNR), entropy, Mean Square error (MSE) and Correlation Coefficient (CC).

articleTitle: Proficiency Estimation of Four-Leg DSTATCOM for Compensating Load of Arc Furnace in the Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: This research focuses on the compensation of power quality (PQ) problems introduced by arc furnace (AF) using a static four-leg allocation compensator (FL-DSTATCOM).A time-domainhyperbolic AF model is regarded an unequally disturbed, non-linear fluctuating load and the PQ problems generated by AF are predicted. A FL-DSTATCOM is used to eliminate harmonic current and 3-phase currentdisproportion. At the same time, it cancel-outthe current movementin the unbiassed conductor, balancesthe reactive power and rectifies the poor power factorinduced by the AF in the powersystem distribution. The FL-DSTATCOM insertsreactive and harmonicingredientsof AF current obtainedusing reference frame synchronous theory. In order to measurethe compensation abilityof FL-DSTATCOM at thestatic and dynamic AF loading circumstances, the digital simulation is performedusing MATLAB/ SIMULINK. The simulation results shows that the FL-DSTATCOM is proficientof making the supply current balanced and sinusoidal. Further, the FL-DSTATCOM topology provides smother neutral current compensation compared to commonly used split-capacitor based three-leg DSTATCOM topology.

articleTitle: Salp Swarm Optimization Algorithm Based CME-CV Thresholding for Soil Porous Medium Extraction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Computed tomography (CT) images of soil samples has a clear impact view on the various sizes of porous medium and has great potential to estimate soil void ratio and porosity. Porosity and void ratio of simulated sample are used to find all other physical natures. The soil management system has given such a suitable decision to the humans involved under soil-based professions. In past two decades of years, refers Otsu's interclass variance-based thresholding and Kapur's entropy-based thresholding are assigned for both single and multi- objective solutions. Thresholding is the type of segmentation isused to get all the information of soil samples such as solid, pore and pebble spaces. In recent years, Bio-inspired optimization algorithms are used to enhance boundary efficiency of both foreground and background of objects. Salp Swarm optimization algorithm reimburse the difference between Macropores and micropores of soil samples in an efficient manner. In this analysis reveals efficiency between Salp Swarm Optimization algorithm (SSA) and traditional bio-inspired approaches such as Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Artificial Bee Colony Optimization (ABC).

Author Keywords: Otsu class variance and Kapur maximum entropy

articleTitle: Fault Prediction Model for Wind Energy Conversion Systems-A Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: This paper develops a Neural Network based implementation of the fault identification on the wind turbine model. The prediction algorithm that would predict the algorithm fault that occurs on the wind energy conversion system (WECS) is completely automated using the neural network (NN) algorithm. The fault occurring in the turbine, drive train and the converter is considered, and the automation is carried out by the use of Back Propagation Network Algorithm (BPNA). Matlab based realization using Simulink and M-file functions is carried out and the results are tabulated. The efficient training algorithm and the testing is carried out on the complete wind energy conversion model. The accuracy and the score parameters of the algorithm is analyzed with the previous implementation and tabulated. The results obtained is inferred for satisfactory results. The faults that would deviate the measured speed, measured torque and conversion system faults are gathered on a single NN model.

articleTitle: Analysis of Security Threats and Countermeasures for various Biometric Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Providing security measures to any real time application is the one of the difficult and important task. Biometric is one of the increasingly used technologies to identify and verify the user. It positively provides better security against the identity theft. Biometric technique helps to identify each individual by analysing his/her unique behavioural and physiological features. But in some practical situations, biometric techniques fail to meet the security requirements. Spoofing attacks is one of the major threats in real time environment. Attackers are using the forged biometric traits to gain the access of victim's account and data. In this paper, we have analysed need for biometric techniques compared to traditional techniques for authentication purpose. We have also reviewed about general biometric techniques such as fingerprint, iris-scan, retina-scan, facial recognition, palm scan, voice recognition, signature-based, gait biometrics by analysing both advantages and drawbacks. This paper also discussed about security threats and its positive countermeasures in general biometric techniques.

articleTitle: Grid Integrated Eco-Friendly Pumping System for Active PFC Using Interleaved Boost Converter (IBC) Topology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Proliferation of power-electronic loads on water-pumping systems has led to un-safe and inefficient conditions because of typical low power-factor of power-electronic conditioning systems. Most of the water-pumping systems require an AC-DC conversion followed by DC-DC converter for regulating the outputs. An efficient, viable and simple power-conditioning system is proposed for irrigation application accommodated with knowledge based control schemes. Over the, traditional DC-DC converters, a variety of non-isolated high-voltage gain DC-DC converters are proposed by employing voltage-multiply modules. The proposed multi-output converter is working as interleaved manner draws a continuous current from main source for powering the VSI fed BLDC motor drive. For autonomous irrigation system, an expertise Fuzzy-logic controller is appointed for generation of feasible switching states to enhance the dynamic response and torque-ripple minimization. The evaluation of proposed interleaved boost DC-DC converter scheme has been developed for intelligent irrigation system under constant speed conditions by using Matlab/Simulink tool, results are presented with improved power-factor features.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Predictive Model for Fraud Detection in Motor Insurance using Gradient Boosting Method and Validation with Actuarial Models
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Machine Learning provides greater ability to identify in-depth patterns in the data that are normally invisible or difficult to identify using other methods. One of the major application of it is seen in insurance claims fraud detection, which is a classification problem. In this work, Gradient Boosting Method (GBM) was used to create a predictive model which was applied to motor insurance claims data. The dataset was highly imbalanced; this problem was addressed using Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE). The results achieved were remarkable with F1 score around 98% and the accuracy 99%. This was cross-validated by industry experts using extreme value theory (EVT), an actuarial model. The predictive model presented in this paper can be customized, tested and extended to other lines of business.

articleTitle: Efficient ACO Feature selection algorithm for Image stego anomaly detection based on SPAM features
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: The goal of this paper is to enhance the detection accuracy of steganalysis and to reduce the dimensions of high dimensional feature space by removing the irrelevant features. Feature selection is a significant area of research in steganalysis which can greatly inspires the accuracy in detection. In this paper we have proposed an Ant Colony Optimization feature selection (ACOFS- o( n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) for an exploration on the enhancement of revealing (detection) accuracy. ACO is inspired by the artificial ants can pass through on a directed graph. We have chosen the ACO algorithm that can pass through the directed graph with o (2 n) arcs rather than o ( n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> ) arcs. This greatly reduce the processing time of features and reduced the dimensionality of the feature set extracted from the spatial domain namely Subtractive Pixel Adjacency Matrix (SPAM -686 dimensional), features extracted by steganographic algorithms S-Tools, nsF5, open stego, Hide & Seek. The experimental results show that it significantly improves the detection accuracy and significantly reduces the feature dimensions when comparing with renowned feature selection algorithms.

articleTitle: Electrospun PVA/AGAROSE Blends as Prospective Wound Healing Patches for Foot Ulcers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Foot ulcers are an open sore or wound. Anyone who has diabetes can develop a foot ulcer. Prevention of diabetic foot ulcers and timely treatment of ulcers using effective techniques is the need of the hour. The dressing of the ulcers plays a crucial role in managing the situation. Nanofibrous meshes are being explored as prospective candidates for this purpose. In the current study, for the first time a blend of PVA and agarose has been electrospun and characterized to assess its suitability to function as a wound healing patch. Uniform nanofibres were electrospun into a mat and their physicochemical properties were studied. The electrospun blend performed better than pure PVA electrospun mat in having comparable mechanical properties, better water vapour transmission rate and retained their physical structure when immersed in phosphate buffer solution. All the results indicate the blend electrospun mat's suitability to function as a wound healing patch for foot ulcers.

articleTitle: An Inclination based Progressive Resource Allotment Strategy in Cloud Computing Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Clean Energy and Energy Efficient Electronics Circuit for Sustainable Development (INCCES)
abstract: Cloud computing context procurements provider about registering resources based interest, as and while required. It constructs about virtualization as well as distributed computing towards help price effective utilization about registering resources, underlining scheduled resource adaptability in addition to on request benefits. It enables commerce range awake with downward their resources dependent on requirements. Dealing with the client request makes the difficulties about resource distribution. Virtual Machine (VIM) innovation has been utilized as resource procuring. It remains estimated such utilizing virtualized context would diminish the moderate task reaction time just as implements the task as indicated by the accessibility of resources. Henceforth ViMs were apportioned to client dependent on attributes of the job. Powerful as well as dynamic use about resources in cloud can adjust the heap and maintain a strategic distance from circumstances like moderate keep running of frameworks. This manuscript predominantly focuses allotment of VIM toward the client, supported on considering the qualities of the activity. Primary guideline of the present effort remain that small preference tasks (due date of task remains large) shall not postpone the implementation of high preference tasks (due date of the task remains small) also to dynamically allots VIM resources in support of a client work inside time limit. The ‘Pay according to utilize’ form of distributed computing necessitates a client to lease cloud resources otherwise utilities in support of a timeframe also create instalment as needs be. The present manuscript suggests an interest -based preferred resource distribution method that plans a market-driven sale method to distinguish clients for resource portion dependent on their instalment limits also actualizes an instalment procedure dependent on a purchaser’s utility preferences. A correlation remains drawn among planned allotment system moreover the well known off-line VCG sale method as well as outcomes demonstrate a performance advantage in incomes to utilities supplier, instalments of cloud clients other than guaranteeing an excellent resources usage.
